rules.AUTH-CANONICAL-001: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with one LF, sorted keys, no duplicates or lossy numbers.
rules.AUTH-LIMITS-007: Response/attempt limits and max-attempts equal the fixed constants.
rules.AUTH-LINEAGE-002: Protocol path/hash and predecessor hash equal the frozen candidate lineage.
rules.AUTH-MATRIX-003: Frame calls equal the ordered 35-call matrix with daily_basic at ordinal 35.
rules.AUTH-REFS-006: Capability refs are null; capture/date refs are exact verified PASS artifacts.
rules.AUTH-ROOT-005: Attempt output is the exact kind root plus attempt_id.
rules.AUTH-WINDOW-004: Whole-second +08:00 not_before is not later than not_after and every call remains in-window.
rules.COMMIT-DEADLINE-032: PASS can publish only after on-time post-publication candidate verification.
rules.COMMIT-OUTCOME-033: PASS requires eligible reproduction; every recovery or failure commit is FAIL.
rules.COMMIT-PREBIND-031: Published commit bytes/hash/nonce equal the manifest prospective ref.
rules.DATE-COMMON-OPEN-020: Sampling date is the greatest completed common-open date and next open exists.
rules.DATE-MATRIX-008: Date calls equal ordered SSE then SZSE trade_cal calls.
rules.DATE-RANGE-009: Calendar endpoints equal proposed date minus/plus 62 Gregorian days.
rules.DATE-SOURCES-022: Sources are exactly verified SSE/SZSE receipt and blob refs.
rules.DATE-VALIDITY-021: Validity runs from sampling date 18:00:00 through next common open 17:59:59 +08:00.
rules.LEDGER-COUNTS-018: Counts are exact recomputations over the complete entry list.
rules.LEDGER-ROW-HASH-016: Row hashes type-tag null, boolean, string and exact-number lexemes.
rules.LEDGER-ST-SOURCE-019: st_risk_warning may originate only from stock_basic name normalization.
rules.MANIFEST-CLOSED-SET-027: artifact_files exactly project the sealed child; candidate absence is limited to prebound commit.
rules.MANIFEST-COMMIT-030: Candidate manifest prebinds exact commit bytes and a 256-bit nonce.
rules.MANIFEST-COMPLETE-024: complete means every expected ordinal is success_blob independent of later data-gate failure.
rules.MANIFEST-DISPOSITION-026: Disposition and eligibility booleans are fixed by kind, completeness and overall_pass.
rules.MANIFEST-GATES-025: overall_pass is the conjunction of the attempt-kind evaluated gates.
rules.MANIFEST-GENERATORS-028: Generator refs equal the five independent _v132.py source files.
rules.MANIFEST-PARTITION-023: Expected ordinals are exactly partitioned by success, terminal failure and unattempted.
rules.MANIFEST-REFS-029: Specialized refs project exactly into artifact_files with matching hashes and sizes.
rules.RECEIPT-BLOB-011: Blob states bind all metadata; no-blob states set all blob metadata null.
rules.RECEIPT-CALL-012: Ordinal, call_id and request_description equal the authorization matrix.
rules.RECEIPT-STATE-010: Attempted ordinals have one of three material receipt states; unattempted has no receipt.
rules.RECEIPT-TIME-013: Captured time is in-window and no later than sealed receipt/blob refs.
rules.STOP-ORDINAL-015: next_ordinal is the first unattempted authorization ordinal.
rules.STOP-PRETRANSPORT-014: A stop record exists only for a pre-transport stop.
